planItem: 77.44.7.A — Social Links Inspector property and publish lifecycle
finding: The Social Links URL editor documented that bad destinations would be stopped at publication, but the URL input was not associated with platform-specific validation feedback.
change: Reuse the canonical socialLinkUrl validator for per-row inline feedback. Each URL control points to a unique live status. Empty hrefs remain draft-allowed and do not block other Inspector actions; non-empty invalid destinations show guidance. Valid correction clears the message.
openSourceReview: Reused the project-owned socialLinkUrl allowlist and the existing Composition/IME accessible-feedback pattern. No external code or dependency added.

assertions: empty draft URL does not block creating/editing rows

acceptanceBoundary: This proves the Social Links URL field feedback and the listed browser flows. Full 77.44.7.A remains OPEN / NOT CERTIFIED; manual acceptance stays deferred until the complete Visual Editor is implemented.
